finding: The same material-partonomy defect also occurs in the two Tris buffer candidates: total Tris buffer moiety and Chloride in Tris-HCl buffer are inferred moiety/species descriptions, not explicit material inputs transcribed from the recipes. The source-defined stock strength and pH are valid whole-preparation specifications.
proposed_bounded_fix: Omit unsupported components and component_assertion, retain the 1 M pH 7.5 and 0.5 M pH 8.0 nominal stock descriptions, exact occurrence routes and all holds. Do not infer free-base/salt ratios, HCl inputs or solvent. Preserve the old objects/history and distinguish this from the separate filed #1238 solid-salt grade fix.
